text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I go up to the roof looking for Vodka...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Goin' dopey over fan mail isn't
cool, but
damn if I don't love it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's this? Is that supposed to be
me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
choice_data_list: ファンレター、届いたんだ？

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And yeah, I get fan mail sometimes too,
y'know...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This one's got a drawing of me in it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha, it doesn't look anything like me
though.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I look so much cooler than this when I'm
running.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure some kid did their best to draw
this for
me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Stuff like this always speaks more to me
than a
bunch of writing.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna let the kid down, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win the next race by a mile
and show
everyone how cool I really am!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey! If ya keep starin' off into space, I'm
just
gonna leave ya here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the young fan's letter has got
Vodka
all fired up.
